title: Phase II Study of Pembrolizumab in HER2-Negative Breast Cancer
text:
Inclusion Criteria: Histologically confirmed breast cancer. Age 18 years or older. ECOG performance status 0-2. No chemotherapy within the past 30 days prior to enrollment. Platelet count >= 100,000/uL.
Exclusion Criteria: Pregnant or nursing women. Known active liver disease. Prior treatment with anti-PD1/PD-L1 therapy.
